title: Release and Quality Baseline
acceptance_criteria: A clean environment can install the released CLI and run the supported command surface when a release is published.
Every committed Python test module is executed or rejected by deterministic validation.
Direct changes cannot reach main without all required repository gates.
Release artifacts are reproducible and carry stable versions/checksums/contracts when published.
